combo_label: Buses & Coaches × Architecture × Samurai & Feudal Japan

entries.clue: Of the short-hop town bus, as against the fast run to the coast
Glossy tree-sap finish built up in thin layers on bowls, boxes and armour
Bell-ringing crew member who once worked the platform of a Routemaster
Political self-destruction; in Japan, a fatal stroke to one's own belly
Covert agent hired for espionage, sabotage and murder in the dark
Either arm of the cross a great church is laid out on
Glassed-in nook at the front of a bus, holding the wheel and the pedals
Pencil-thin turret beside a mosque, climbed by the muezzin
Carved cypress face, a jealous demon's or a young girl's, worn on the stage
Roofed roadside refuge with a bench for those waiting
Beam or rod fixed across a building to stop the walls spreading
A tower and its point taken together, a landmark for miles
